actions.label: Encrypt Sensitive Information
actions.definition: Encrypt sensitive data such as ML models to protect against adversaries attempting to access sensitive data.

actions.label: Encryption
actions.definition: Encrypting the model’s code, training data, and other sensitive information can prevent attackers from being able to access and steal the model.

actions.label: Reducing the training data
actions.definition: Reducing the size of the training dataset or removing redundant or highly correlated features can help reduce the information an attacker can gain from a membership inference attack.

subgoals.control_name: Determine the legal authority and other requirements to process personally identifiable information.

subgoals.goal_name: Determine the legal authority and other requirements to process personally identifiable information

actions.label: Process Self-Modification Detection
actions.definition: Detects processes that modify, change, or replace their own code at runtime.

actions.label: Process Spawn Analysis
actions.definition: Analyzing spawn arguments or attributes of a process to detect processes that are unauthorized.

actions.label: Process Lineage Analysis
actions.definition: Identification of suspicious processes executing on an end-point device by examining the ancestry and siblings of a process, and the associated metadata of each node on the tree, such as process execution, duration, and order relative to siblings and ancestors.
